description: Instructional airframe at an aeronautical-trades lycée, transferred by the Service de Rayonnement de la Marine.  Listed by ARDHAN (Claude Morin), 'Aeronefs preserves de l'Aeronautique navale', August 2025, section 5 'Lycees professionnels'. These airframes were transferred by the Service de Rayonnement de la Marine to schools teaching aeronautical trades.
